summary: On z/OS the Python 3 interpreter usually lives somewhere like /usr/lpp/cyp/v3r12/pyz rather than /usr/bin/python, so set ansible_python_interpreter. Otherwise you may see the error '/usr/bin/python: FSUM7351 not found'.
questions: What does FSUM7351 not found mean when running Ansible on z/OS?
How do I point Ansible at Python on a z/OS host?
Where is Python usually installed on z/OS?

answer_card.title: Setting the Python interpreter for z/OS hosts
answer_card.answer_md:
Ansible looks for Python at `/usr/bin/python`, but on z/OS IBM Open Enterprise SDK for Python is often at a path like `/usr/lpp/cyp/v3r12/pyz`. Set it in inventory:

```ini
zos1 ansible_python_interpreter:/usr/lpp/cyp/v3r12/pyz
```

If it isn't set, you may get: `/usr/bin/python: FSUM7351 not found`.
